data.one_liner: A Dart-based task runner and build system for defining and executing tasks.
data.what_it_does: Dartle lets you declare tasks in plain Dart code and runs only the tasks that need to run based on input/output changes. It executes tasks in parallel isolates and supports custom run conditions.
use_when: You need a lightweight, pure‑Dart build system for Dart/Flutter projects
You want incremental builds with up‑to‑date checking
You prefer defining build logic in code rather than DSLs
avoid_when: You need a full‑featured GUI CI tool
Your build involves non‑Dart languages or native toolchains
weaknesses: Less mature than established tools like Gradle
No built‑in support for non‑Dart tasks
data.setup_notes: Add dartle to dev_dependencies, import package:dartle/dartle.dart, define Task objects and call run() in a dartle.dart file.

alternatives.name: watcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides file‑system watching without the full task‑runner features, useful if you only need change detection
